cases.input:
---
name: one-review
description: Reply alternatives conformance vector.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [lead, reviewer]
---
"""
One lead asks one reviewer for a review.
"""
contract @1h => expired
"""
The lead asks for the review.
"""
role lead
"""
The reviewer answers with a review.
"""
role reviewer
"""
A request for a review.
"""
type request
  text: text(1..2000)
"""
The review of one request.
"""
type review
  request: ref(request)
  text: text(1..4000)
"""
Nothing has been asked yet.
"""
state new
  """
  Waiting for the reviewer's review of this request.
  """
  lead -> reviewer: request()
    => review() & collected
     | @5m & stalled
end collected
end stalled
cases.notes: The implied request_wait takes the documented head's prompt.
